Filter maintenance and water changes are crucial for long term water clarity, but sometimes the debris in the water causing it to be cloudy can be so small that it slips through the filter quite easily. This is where water clarifying agents like these AquaPacs can help. They bind up these smaller particles into larger conglomerates that are more easily pulled from the water by the filter. Must haves for your tank. Tap water conditioner and Sludge destroyer. The additives in tap water suck as chlorine are harmful to your babies. Chlorine can cause health issues and deformities to your turtles shell, this is why you use water conditioner. If you have a large tank, get the super strength water conditioner, smaller tanks like a 20 or 40 gallon tank, you can start off with regular strength. You also need to have the sludge destroyer. This helps break down waste and debris like food particles in the tank. To be clear, sludge destroyer is a clearish liquid that has good bacteria to help your tank. With every water change, you want to add these to your tank. I hope this helps someone who is new to turtle life! #turtle #update #todo #aquaticlife #happyfriday
